title: Exhaustive coverage manifest contract for unresolved continuity identifiers

observed: The canonical queue requires exhaustive branch or equivalent repository-history coverage before M-004, M-005, or M-006 may be classified as unlocated.
Repository code search is not indexed, so zero connector search results are non-exhaustive.

File Library results contain suffix-shaped identifiers such as V8-004 and V9-004, but no immutable object assigning the continuity namespace identifiers M-004, M-005, or M-006 was located in this run.
inferred: Identifier suffix agreement without namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and immutable locator agreement is a collision, not provenance.
A negative provenance conclusion is valid only when the exact searched object universe and traversal completion are retained and independently checkable.
proposed: Require every exhaustive reconciliation run to emit a coverage manifest containing repository identity, starting refs, tags, reachable commit count, tree count, blob count, query bytes, excluded objects, traversal errors, completion state, and SHA-256 digests of raw outputs.

Permit transition from unresolved to unlocated only when completion_state is complete, excluded_objects is empty or explicitly accepted, traversal_errors is empty, and no namespace-qualified immutable match exists.
superseded: Treating suffix-equivalent File Library records as candidates capable of resolving continuity-owned M-series identifiers.
Treating zero unindexed connector search results as repository-wide absence evidence.
unresolved: Immutable provenance and originating source for M-004.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-005.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-006.
Execution of the exhaustive manifest-producing traversal.

coverage_manifest_contract.promotion_rule: unlocated is permitted only from complete coverage with no unaccepted exclusions, no traversal errors, and no immutable namespace-qualified match

falsification_route: Produce an immutable source object predating the current reconciliation records that explicitly assigns M-004, M-005, or M-006 within the continuity namespace, or execute a complete manifest-backed traversal showing no such object exists.
next_action: Implement and run the manifest-producing exhaustive ref, tag, commit, tree, and blob traversal; retain raw outputs and digests before changing any unresolved claim.
